channel.title: HeyDot
channel.description: HeyDot's update feed, read by Sparkle in the app. Each release adds one signed item; see docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.

item.title: Version 0.2.5
item.description:
HeyDot now learns how you say your dot's name

  • Voice tuning that listens to you. Say the phrase four times, your way. Fast speech and unusual names work. If you tuned before, run Settings > Voice tuning again.
  • No pause needed. Saying "hey" and the name quickly now wakes your dot, and more names wake reliably on standard settings.
  • Setup finds your dot after you sign in and fills in its link.
  • A tidier dot designer and steadier setup screens.
  • Erase and Start Over in Settings > Privacy.
  • Fixes: reopening setup no longer keeps the microphone busy, and tuning is never saved under the wrong phrase.
